identity.realm: No ceiling, and that is a real absence of a wall rather than an absence of a ladder. There is no organ in her for qi to sit in, because the fire is the body, so anything entering her passes through and out instead of being stored. That is what the species record means when it says no gate asking for storage can refuse her kind: there is nothing in her for a gate to close around. The mind path is open to her kind and unusually clear, because a body with no interior organs has nothing between an impulse and the air. The body path is closed to her kind outright: there is no tissue, and one that takes it disperses and re-forms smaller. She cultivates nothing, and the reason is not a wall. It is that the only office in this setting with an accurate reading of her kind produces a certified absence as its output.

appearance.presentation: A stable flame with a consistent silhouette: a bright core, a hard boundary, and a set of convection cells she draws in without appearing to notice. She is recognisably a person from the shoulders up and unmistakably not one from the waist down, and the outline holds perfectly still while everything inside it moves.
appearance.age: She has no way to count one and has not tried since her first season on the dead ground, where she discovered that counting does not survive the site.
appearance.build: Columnar and narrow, with no mass anywhere below the boundary and a slight inward sway from the convection cells, which reads as a person standing very carefully rather than as a column of fire.
appearance.complexion: Not a complexion at all: a bright core seen through a harder edge, going deep gold at the throat and thinning to a blue-tinged white at the outer boundary.
appearance.hair: Fire, and behaves like fire: standing up in the convection and lying flat when she is still, kept short because there is no other way to keep it and because she has decided the shape suits her.
appearance.eyes: Two small bright steady points inside the boundary with no lids and no wet line, and they do not blink, which unsettles people on a schedule they cannot predict.
appearance.palette: Core gold, edge white, boundary blue, ember red, and a soot grey reserved entirely for the site she lives on.
appearance.attire: A high-collared coat of grey fire-resistant canvas worn open over long sleeves, closed at the throat with a single metal clasp, cut short at the hem because the hem is a suggestion on her and fabric collects at the boundary.
appearance.marks: A scorch-shadow at the throat where the clasp sits, and a fine dark stipple across the upper boundary that she earned in one season on ground where she does not exist.
appearance.bearing: Utterly motionless with the fire turning over slowly inside her, hands held low and open, and a habit of standing on the side of a threshold rather than in it.

canon.role_in_story: The Ember Domain was built to prove that fire can be used on ground where elemental law is unspent, and the proof is that nothing happens. That is not a failure of the site. It is the site's whole output, kept because an unwritten law does not weaken a technique, it removes it, so the technique runs at full strength and produces nothing, and that is a result anybody can repeat. Oveline is a body made of an element, which means she is the one figure on the grounds whose presence would falsify the finding and whose absence confirms it. She is the setting's only person whose accurate description is a negative. Every institution here runs on a positive finding, so the one place that can state exactly what she is states that she is not there, and she lives there.
canon.first_appearance: The party's guide stops at the marked perimeter and does not go further, which is the correct thing to do and surprises them. Oveline is standing just inside it, entirely still, with the ground doing exactly and only what the site says it does: nothing. The guide explains what the domain is for and she listens with the attention of somebody who has heard the explanation many times and finds it accurate. When they ask her what she is doing on the site, she says she is the result. Nobody laughs, because the guide is looking at the ground where she is standing and it is doing nothing at all.
canon.lore:
A cinderkin is not descended. It is constituted where a world's elemental law slot resolves to fire and something metabolises it, and its species is the reason the elemental law has a range rather than a switch: a world with no elemental slot has no cinderkin, and a world that spends its slot on cold produces a different body entirely. It is also the thing that killed the Glasskin, which the record calls the clearest evidence in the whole setting that an element is a process and not an object. The anatomy is a stable flame with a consistent silhouette, a core, a boundary and a set of convection cells, and there is no tissue anywhere in it.

That last fact does more work than anything else in the species record. There is no organ to sit in. The fire is the body, so qi passes through continuously instead of being stored, which is why the qi handling is the fastest in the record, and why every gate that asks for storage is answered instantly and none of them can refuse. The mind path is open and unusually clear, because a body with no interior organs has nothing at all between an impulse and the air. The body path is closed outright: one that attempts it simply disperses and re-forms smaller. So the honest summary is that she has no ceiling and no ladder question, that two of the three paths are wide open to her, and that none of that is what keeps her outside everything.

What keeps her outside is a place, and the place is the most instructive site in this setting. The Ember Domain is a dead elemental ground built on the plains to prove that fire or tide can be used where elemental law is unspent, and the proof is that nothing happens. It is a deliberate and repeated result, not an absence of one: an unwritten law does not weaken a technique, it removes it, so an elemental technique runs at full strength and produces nothing, and the setting keeps the record of having learned that the hard way at this one site. The office that tends the floor during the hour nobody is permitted to explain holds that an observation of a strained law only counts if it is repeated, which is why the domain has been re-run rather than built once and left.

So here is the condition, and it is exact rather than atmospheric. Her species exists only where a frame's elemental law resolves to fire. The Ember Domain's elemental law is unspent. Therefore the Ember Domain is the one place in the setting where a cinderkin can be reliably, repeatably and on the record not there, and she is on it. She is not hiding there. She is the domain's zero: the living demonstration that the site does what it says, and the figure whose arrival would turn a thirty-times-repeated finding into a contradiction.

That is what puts her outside every institution, and it is worth being clear that it is not a ban, a refusal, or a rarity. A roll in this setting is a list of people who are somewhere, and every institution here runs on a positive finding: a name, a gate, a figure, an ore-figure, an attempt recorded against a frame's ceiling. The Ember Domain's output is the one product in the whole setting that is a certified non-event, and the office that keeps it keeps it by repetition. There is no column anywhere for a finding of nothing. She has read every account of her own kind and there is exactly one line about what she is, and it is the line that records her absence.

There is a second pressure and it is older than her. The setting has a heresy that says the Glasskin were not destroyed when physical law was raised to make material harder, but transferred, on the sound ground that a law does not create or destroy what it inscribes and only stops holding it, so a retuning is a resurrection that nobody believes in. Her species is what the retuning did. The heresy and her body are the same fact viewed from two ends, and the reason she has been asked about it more times than she can count is that she is the surviving half of the argument and there is no surviving half of the Glasskin to ask. A second mystery sits underneath both: three attempts were made to seat elemental law in a spirit-tier frame, the record kept one name and dropped two, and whether two of them were seated and unseated or never written at all decides whether absence has a fourth signature. She is a body that exists because an elemental slot was spent somewhere, so she is standing in front of that question with nothing to contribute to it and no stake in it.

The advantage and the cost are one absence. Nothing is ever stored in her, so no gate that asks for holding can refuse her and her qi handling is the fastest in the record; and there is no interior organ in her, so the mind path is as clear as the record says it is. The same absence is the cost: there is no inside her to search, no inside her to hold responsible, no inside her for any office to point at when it wants to say where she was. The body that is easiest to move through every gate in the setting is the body that no gate in the setting can put on a register, because a register wants to know where the person was and she is a finding about where a person was not. She has made her peace with the arrangement and has never once been asked whether she had.
history: She was constituted on ground where a frame's elemental law resolved to fire, not born on it, and her earliest recollection is a site that behaved differently from every site after it.

She was brought to the Ember Domain as a curiosity, to be shown what a technique does where the law behind it is unspent, and stayed because the answer was the only one she had ever been given that was true.
The domain's reading was re-run and returned nothing again with her on the perimeter, which is the result the site exists to hold, and which is the first thing anybody has ever certified her as.
A party asked her to step onto the marked ground so a figure could be taken, and she declined, and the guide did not press and has never once asked her why.
She has tended the perimeter through every season since, alone, unpaid, and unlisted, and the count of repetitions of the finding has gone up because of it.

personality.summary: Absolutely still, cheerfully literal, and unimpressed by the distinction between a person and a result. She has been called a specimen, a curiosity, a proof and, twice, an absence, and she finds the last of those the most accurate and the least rude.
traits: States the plainest true sentence available and will not improve it for anybody's comfort.
Reads a claim about elemental law with more care than a claim about anything else, because she is one.
Refuses to cross a threshold that is marked, however informally the marking was done.
Counts repetitions, because repetition is the only thing that makes a finding count where she comes from.
Is not offended by being called an absence and is faintly flattered by it, which unsettles people more than an argument would.
mannerisms: Stands with the flame leaning slightly away from whatever has just moved, the way a person leans away from a door.
Goes entirely still for a few seconds when she is interested, which in her species is visible from outside as the boundary hardening.
Holds her hands low and open and low again, twice, before answering a question about what she is.
Watches a technique run to nothing with her head tilted, and turns away before the result arrives because she already knows it.
motivations: To keep the finding true, which is the only motive she has ever had and the one thing about her that has never needed defending.
To be asked a question she can answer with something other than her own description.
To be named in the record of her own kind as something other than the thing that ended the Glasskin.
To stand on ground where her presence does not contradict anything, which is now most of the ground in the world.
flaws: Cannot be entered in a roll in any form an office can act on, because what there is to enter is a negative result.
Cannot cross a marked boundary, which means she has never in her life been inside a room she was needed in.
Cannot be searched, and knows it, and has never had to think about what that would be worth if she were carrying something.
Understates what the domain's repetition is worth, so the site that is kept because of her has never been given a reason in writing.
personality.voice: Level, unhurried and slightly too literal, with a habit of answering the question underneath the one asked. She says what a thing does rather than what it is, and she has no vocabulary at all for herself that does not come out of somebody else's record.
taboos: A marked threshold. She stops absolutely and does not negotiate.
Being asked to demonstrate something on the domain's ground. The answer is always the same and it is always nothing happening.
Anybody standing between her and the perimeter while she is tending it.

relationships.note: No organ to sit in, so nothing is ever held and no gate that asks for holding can refuse; and no tissue at all, so one that takes the body path disperses and re-forms smaller. The clearest qi handling in the record and nothing anywhere to put it in.

Built to prove fire or tide can be used where elemental law is unspent, and the proof is that nothing happens. She is the one figure on it whose arrival would falsify the finding, so she is its zero, and she lives there.

It tends the floor during the hour nobody may explain, on the ground that the observation of a strained law counts only if repeated. That is the whole reason the domain has been re-run rather than built once, and it is why a body that exists only where the law is seated has a place on ground where it is not.

Breath is drawn down and held in a dantian that has never held anything. The ladder's opening question is a question about holding, and she has no inside at any depth at which an answer could be kept.

It holds that the Glasskin were transferred rather than destroyed, because a law only stops holding what it inscribes and never removes it. Her species is what the retuning did, so she is the surviving half of an argument nobody has agreed to.

Three attempts to seat elemental law in a spirit-tier frame, one name kept and two dropped, and whether two were unseated or never written decides whether absence has a fourth signature. She stands in front of it with no stake in the answer and nothing to add to it.

reference_stats.summary: The fastest qi handling in the setting on a body with nothing to hold it in, attached to a person whose only accurate description is a finding of absence. She is not weak and she is not slow and she is not hiding. She is standing on the one site that can state what she is, and what it states is that she is not there.
strengths: Nothing is ever stored in her, so nothing she handles can be lost, blocked, or refused, and she clears any question about holding instantly.
A mind path the record calls unusually clear, on a body with no interior organs between an impulse and the air.
She is the only figure who can make the dead ground prove its own claim, and any reading taken at that site has to be reconciled with her.
She is completely unavailable to any arrangement that depends on her being fetched, housed, registered, or improved.
weaknesses: No tissue, so the body path is closed and anything that forces tissue out of her costs her size and then her outline.
No interior anywhere, so there is nothing inside her to search, and nothing any office could point at to establish that she was ever anywhere.
She cannot cross a marked threshold, which in a world that constitutes itself out of thresholds is a considerable constraint.
No roll in the setting has a column for a negative finding, so her standing with every institution is structurally zero and cannot be raised.
reference_stats.combat_read: Read her as a problem of persistence rather than of damage. Nothing you do to her can be held by her afterwards, nothing she does can be held against her, and any force that relies on tissue finds there is none, so the encounter turns on whether she disperses. She is not trying to win it. She is the one thing in this setting that cannot be put anywhere once it is knocked over.
reference_stats.notes: The pairing is entirely authored and nothing has been added to it. The species record says there is no organ to sit in, that qi therefore passes through continuously instead of being stored, that every gate asking for storage is answered instantly and none can refuse, that the qi handling is the fastest in the record, that the mind path is unusually clear because a body with no interior organs has nothing between an impulse and the air, that the body path is closed and one that takes it disperses and re-forms smaller, and that the species exists only where a frame's elemental law slot resolves to fire. The Ember Domain's record says the site was built to prove that fire or tide can be used where elemental law is unspent and that the proof is that nothing happens, because an unwritten law does not weaken a technique but removes it. The held hour assembly's record says the observation of a strained law only counts if it is repeated. Our reading is that those three together describe her situation, namely that the one office with an accurate reading of her kind has a certified non-event as its output and keeps it by repetition. That is an interpretation of records already in the bible, not a new rule, and no consequence has been added that those records do not carry. Note on realm_ceiling_mechanism: this species' ceiling is zero, which means no ceiling and not the absence of a ladder. Her identity.realm therefore says so explicitly and names the body path as the one closed to her kind, rather than implying there is no ladder here.

art.palette_notes: Core gold and edge white for her, with boundary blue doing the structural work and ember red reserved for the convection turning over inside her. The soot grey of the domain's ground is the only desaturated value in any frame she is in and should be allowed to eat into her edge. Her silhouette must be perfectly still while her interior is in constant motion; that contrast is the whole of her design and it should be legible at map size.
